title: RDW–albumin interaction does not show robust added CRP prediction beyond nonlinear components and their ratio
abstract: We tested whether joint erythrocyte heterogeneity and albumin contain concurrent inflammatory information beyond their marginal nonlinearities and an established RDW/albumin ratio. Models were fit in 5,217 NHANES 2007–08 adults and frozen before application to 5,610 independently sampled 2009–10 adults. In 5,610 independently sampled NHANES 2009–10 adults, a frozen RDW×albumin interaction gave only a 0.214% weighted log-CRP MSE point gain beyond quadratic components, their ratio and WBC (delta 0.002323; approximate 95% interval -0.001745 to 0.006551), and the gain reversed with cubic marginals. Reliable added information is not established. This is a negative robustness result for a particular engineered feature, not a mortality analysis or clinical validation.
